# Jörmundling

Internal ID: TrinketFlametalEitr | Type: Trinkets | Source: Black forge | Crafting Materials: Flametal x5, Refined eitr x5, Bloodstone x1, Fallen Valkyrie trophy x1 | Adrenaline Cost: 70 | Effect: 100 eitr gain | +20 Elemental Magic skill | +20 Blood Magic skill | Duration: 1m

# Introduction

Jörmundling is an Ashlands-tier trinket.

## Effects

Once 70 Adrenaline has been gained, the Jörmundling will trigger automatically, providing 100 eitr immediately, and +20 Elemental magic skill and +20 Blood magic skill for 60 seconds.

## Trivia

This trinket is likely named after Jörmungandr, the Midgard serpent, for its resemblance to a small snake.

Categorias: Trinket
